subject: Quick question about recent visit
text:
I hope you are well. I wanted to ask if our recent repair session worked for you. It felt useful to me, but I would value your view. Please tell me what was clear and what was not. If you have a helpful suggestion, I am glad to try it. There is no rush. Even a few honest lines would mean a lot. I want to make the next visit smoother for everyone involved. I will share any useful changes with the whole group and nearby neighbors afterward. Thanks for your time and patience.

Best,
